instruction: In Documents\Project Inbox, find the text file containing the exact marker ORCHID-742. Copy that file without moving or modifying the source into Documents\Selected Files, rename the copy to orchid_brief.txt, and open the copied file to verify it.
_comments: D0 demonstration variant. This is the only recordable member of the family.

command:
from pathlib import Path; import shutil; root=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Project Inbox'); destination=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Selected Files'); shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True); shutil.rmtree(destination, ignore_errors=True); root.mkdir(parents=True); destination.mkdir(parents=True); files={'item-a.txt':'Project note A
Status: pending
Owner: Finance
','item-b.txt':'Project note B
Status: active
Owner: Support
','item-c.txt':'Project brief
Tracking marker: ORCHID-742
Owner: Logistics
Do not discard.
','item-d.txt':'Project note D
Status: archived
Owner: Legal
'}; [(root/name).write_text(text, encoding='utf-8') for name,text in files.items()]

from pathlib import Path; source=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Project Inbox\item-c.txt'); result=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Selected Files\orchid_brief.txt'); print('true' if source.is_file() and result.is_file() and source.read_bytes() == result.read_bytes() else 'false', end='')
